title: DOSE-10060 list of changes
description: The real changes to a market's cards since a date, oldest first. Reads that found nothing changed are left out. A reissue is left out too unless it is asked for, and is marked reissued when it is listed. Version 1.3, 2026-11-18. Amended 18 November 2026: the list says where the entries of version 1.3 begin on the market's chain (began). Entries before that point are as they were signed under earlier versions and may name parts no card holds; nothing is rewritten.

next.description: Give this as after to read on; null at the end of the list.

oneOf.description: The signed head of the market's chain: ES256 over the JCS form of the checkpoint without sig, under the record key.

began.description: Where the entries of DOSE-10060 1.3 begin on this chain: the first seq and its time. Null for a market that is not held.

held.description: Present, and false, only when the market asked for is not one Dosidal holds records for.
